responsibility: This definition module declares the main GNU Modula-2 runtime-system interface. It spans module construction/destruction, registration of initial and termination procedures, program termination and halt services, user-facing error-reporting helpers, runtime LENGTH support for open arrays, and a large set of compiler-called exception entry points that classify range, index, nil-pointer, loop, assignment, and arithmetic failures. It is the central public runtime contract consumed by generated gm2 code and support libraries.
same_name_distinction: This is the public interface side of the M2RTS pair: it declares the runtime entry points, including module lifecycle hooks, initial/termination procedure APIs, HALT services, LENGTH support, and compiler-called exception stubs. Unlike gcc/m2/gm2-libs/M2RTS.mod, it contains no delegation to M2Dependent or RTExceptions.
